install.ios:
iPhone / iPad install:
1. Tap the Share button (square with up arrow) at the bottom
2. Scroll down and pick 'Add to Home Screen'
3. Tap 'Add' on the top right
install.android:
Android install:
1. Open the browser menu (⋮ at the top right)
2. Pick 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen'

If you don't see this option, please open the page in Chrome. Some in-app browsers (LINE, Facebook) don't support PWA install — please switch to a system browser.
install.fallback: Look for 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install app' in the browser menu.

tos.title: LiveChord Terms of Service
tos.p.service_intro: LiveChord is a music chord analysis and learning tool. The current build offers:
tos.li.browse_db: Browse the existing chord database (54,000+ songs)
tos.li.upload_detect: Upload an audio file for automatic chord detection
tos.li.youtube_extract: Extract chords from a YouTube URL
tos.li.audio_only_for_analysis: Uploaded audio is used only for chord analysis and deleted right after
tos.li.audio_kept_10min: Audio is retained for at most 10 minutes, then automatically purged
tos.li.no_audio_copy: We do not keep any audio file copies on the server
tos.li.keep_only_results: Only analysis results (chord progressions, key) are kept
tos.li.daily_quota: Each user may process at most 10 new songs per day
tos.li.personal_use_only: This service is for personal music study only
tos.li.data_for_quality: Generated chord data may be used to improve service quality
tos.li.anon_stats: Anonymous usage stats help us understand which features people use
tos.li.no_third_party: Personal information is never shared with third parties
tos.li.ai_accuracy: Chord analysis is AI-generated; accuracy may be limited
tos.li.beta_uptime: The service may be unstable; uptime is not guaranteed
tos.li.user_legality: Users are responsible for ensuring uploaded content complies with local law
